summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests [225Ac]Ac-AKY-1189, a Nectin-4 radiopharmaceutical, in people with previously treated locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, including the listed cancer types. The drug is given as an injection, and how often and for how long it is given is not stated. The study measures safety and efficacy and aims to find the maximum tolerated or administered dose and the recommended Phase 2 dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa [225Ac]Ac-AKY-1189, un radiofármaco dirigido a Nectina-4, en personas con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados o metastásicos que ya recibieron tratamiento previo, incluidos los tipos de cáncer enumerados. El medicamento se administra como inyección, y en el registro no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, y busca determinar la dosis máxima tolerada o administrada y la dosis recomendada para fase 2.
who_for: Histologic or cytologic confirmation of locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor
At least one measurable tumor lesion on CT per RECIST v1.1
Documented progression on prior therapy for metastatic disease
Adequate end-organ function and ability to give informed consent; CNS metastases allowed if neurologically stable
not_for: Prior treatment with a therapeutic radiopharmaceutical
Prior Nectin-4 targeted therapy, except enfortumab vedotin
Investigational agent received within the previous 28 days
Chemotherapy, targeted therapy, biologic, immunotherapy or external-beam radiotherapy within 3 weeks before study treatment
Serious medical condition that would impair participation or affect toxicity assessment
